summary: Scranton seamstress, daughter of a Farr Street shoemaker, who married Ralph A. Cognetti in 1940 and lived to about 101; wife of John's great-uncle.
bio:
Marguerite Forgione, recorded as Margaret on her marriage licence, was born in Scranton about 1913, one of at least nine children of Peter Forgione, an Italian-born shoemaker, and his wife Elizabeth D'Ettore. In 1940 she was a 26-year-old seamstress living with her family on Farr Street, and on 1 June that year she married Ralph A. Cognetti, the eldest brother of John's grandmother Mary Cognetti Petriello. By 1950 she was keeping house for Ralph and their four children.

She outlived Ralph by five years and was still living in Scranton in 2012, when her sister Amelia Amori's obituary named her among the survivors. Family records give her death as 30 May 2014 in Scranton, at about 101.
